_meta.note: Cute creature set for region 1 (Gary 2:19 PM CT Oct 23 2026: 'we need a set of cute ones as well for other players we can throw them in at the end of the game 6 per region'). Held out of encounter tables until Gary places them. All single-stage (stay cute; no evolution that turns them 'cool'). Built by coder_cute_r1.
_meta.dex_no: PROVISIONAL numbers after the 450 plan and coder_new_evos 451-453, until Gary/World Design slot them. DEX_450 itself is not edited; tools/sync_creatures.mjs reads design/cute_sets/cute_r*.json.

wild.why: Gary Oct 27 2026: region 1 cute set lives in region 1 grass, mixed with existing spawns

creatures.name: Drizzlebill
creatures.habitat: Brookhollow riverbank shallows and puddles after rain (proposed: bh_river_fish / route1_water edges)
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby baby platypus-like river critter: teal-blue fur, cream belly, soft pale-blue bill, raindrop-shaped paddle tail, raindrop freckles on cheeks, huge dark eyes. Crystal: small violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Mossmote
creatures.habitat: Trail 1 damp stones and mossy bank by the stream (proposed: sunmeadow_grass, low weight)
creatures.visual_brief: Plump tardigrade-inspired 'water bear': sage-green segmented barrel body, cream underside, eight stubby legs with mauve toe-pads, moss saddle with two dewdrops, big sparkly eyes, little 'o' mouth. Crystal: violet crystal growing from the moss on its back.

creatures.name: Gladlet
creatures.habitat: Fernwick cottage gardens and flowerbeds at sunrise (proposed: Fernwick garden grass, rare)
creatures.visual_brief: Round quokka-inspired garden spirit sitting upright: honey-cream fur, pink inner ears, huge smile with rosy cheeks, pink blossom-petal tuft on its forehead, fluffy tail with a pale-gold wisp tip. Crystal: violet crystal pendant at its chest.

creatures.name: Buoyling
creatures.habitat: Lanternport harbour, bobbing between moored boats (proposed: lp_harbour / lanternport_water)
creatures.visual_brief: Baby manatee-inspired sea calf resting upright on its paddle tail: powder blue-grey skin, cream belly, whiskery round snout, small flippers, a red-and-white striped float ring around its middle (natural markings, like a harbour float). Crystal: violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Lumoris
creatures.habitat: Greystone Caverns glowfern pockets (proposed: greystone_glowfern, rare)
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy baby slow-loris-inspired cave puffball: silvery-blue and white fur, enormous amber eyes in dark-teal eye rings, tiny round ears, hugs a glowing teal fern frond. Crystal: violet crystal on its forehead.

creatures.name: Pandember
creatures.habitat: Thornwood forest, curled on sun-warmed stones and old charcoal-burner clearings (proposed: thornwood_grass)
creatures.visual_brief: Round red-panda-inspired cub: rusty red-orange fur, cream face and ear markings, dark brown legs, big glossy eyes, huge ringed tail whose rings glow ember-orange like cooling lava (no flames). Crystal: violet crystal on top of its head between the ears.
